morphology.pattern_note: ber- 表示具有或存在某种事由；接 sebab 时保留词根首音 s，不发生鼻音同化。

senses.zh_definition: 有原因、有缘由或有某种理由；并非无缘无故。
senses.en_definition: To have a cause, reason, or grounds.
senses.nuances: 是不及物状态动词，说明存在原因；不自动表示理由正当、充分或行为合理。不能直接代替表示“导致”的 menyebabkan。释义据 [PRPM：sebab](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=+sebab)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Penangguhan itu bersebab, dan pihak pengurusan akan memberikan penjelasan bertulis kepada semua peserta.
dual_scenarios.zh: 此次延期事出有因，管理方将向所有参与者提供书面说明。
dual_scenarios.en: There is a reason for the postponement, and management will provide all participants with a written explanation.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dia marah tu bersebab, bukan saja-saja nak cari gaduh.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kemarahannya bersebab; dia bukan sengaja hendak mencetuskan pergaduhan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 他生气是有原因的，不是故意找架吵。
dual_scenarios.en: He's upset for a reason; he's not just trying to pick a fight.
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语形式
saja-saja 在此表示故意或无端
bukan 用于否定被归于对方的动机

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Oh, patutlah. Aku dengar cerita dia dulu lah.
messages.ms_standard: Oh, patutlah. Saya akan mendengar penjelasannya terlebih dahulu.
messages.zh: 哦，难怪。那我先听听他怎么说吧。
messages.en: Oh, that explains it. I'll hear his side first.

etymology.historical_story: Bersebab combines the Malay prefix ber-, expressing possession or a state, with sebab, a borrowing from Arabic sabab, meaning a cause or reason. The formation shows how a borrowed noun can participate in Malay grammar. Its literal structure, 'having a reason', also explains why the word need not imply that the reason is morally acceptable. [Malayic historical study](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/4498/1/bahasa%20melayik%20purba%20rekontruksi%20fonologi%20dan%20sebagian%20dari%20leksikon%20dan%20morfologi%201994.pdf), [PRPM: sebab](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=+sebab)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ber- 想成“带有”，sebab 是“原因”：bersebab 就是“带着原因发生”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 说对方的情绪 bersebab 可以表示愿意理解其处境；涉及争执时，先听解释比直接断言谁有理更稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合说明行为或事件事出有因。若要明确表达理由充分，应补充 alasannya munasabah；bersebab 本身不承担这种评价。
